item.title: PRESIDENT RUTO ASSENTS TO FOUR BILLS AT STATE HOUSE
item.dc:creator: State House
item.description: President William Ruto on Tuesday signed into law four Bills at State House, Nairobi. The President assented to the Kenya National Council for Population and Development Bill, 2026, the Public Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, the Cooperatives (Amendment) Bill, 2026, and the Climate Change (Amendment) Bill, 2026. item.title: PRESIDENT RUTO ASSENTS TO PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES BILL

item.description: President William Ruto has assented to the Persons with Disabilities Bill 2025, describing it as a progressive law that guarantees the rights of persons with disabilities (PWDs) to education, employment, healthcare, political participation, and access to buildings and public spaces.
